app_store.name: Linecraft: Player Prop Stats
app_store.subtitle: Hit rates, matchups, prices
app_store.promotional_text: Every rating shows its five inputs, so you can see exactly why a prop scores the way it does.
app_store.description:
Linecraft is a research tool for player props. It is not a sportsbook and takes no bets.

Every prop today across basketball, football, baseball and hockey, with:
- Hit rates over the last 5, 10 and 20 games and the season
- Head-to-head against tonight's opponent, home and away splits
- Opponent rank against the position
- A 0-100 rating that shows its five inputs and their weights
- Every book's line and price side by side
- Alt lines and a saved-props shortlist

Free covers the first game of the day in every sport. Pro opens every game.

21+. If gambling stops being fun, call 1-800-GAMBLER.
